v1_limitation: primary metrics were churn/drift not architecture conformance
v2_corrective_action: define architectural conformance directly and tie every claim to a direct metric via a claim-construct-metric matrix
required_evidence: validated direct conformance metrics (G1;G6)

v1_limitation: harness snapshotted a never-reset accumulating tree so churn was monotonic across tasks
v2_corrective_action: each run starts from a clean frozen base SHA in a fresh process with per-cell repetition; independence enforced by the harness and manifest
required_evidence: run manifests with base_sha and repetition; reset protocol

v1_limitation: Delta-CodeLOC/drift used as primary evidence
v2_corrective_action: demote code and test churn to secondary change-footprint metrics; make direct conformance and completeness primary
required_evidence: SAP with direct confirmatory endpoints

v1_limitation: baseline condition could inherit development/machine context
v2_corrective_action: fail-closed context isolation with per-condition allowlists and a CLEAN audit required per run
required_evidence: context_audit CLEAN verdicts; condition allowlists
status: corrective-action-designed; enforced in harness; pending experimental use

v1_limitation: one run per condition cell
v2_corrective_action: pre-register a pilot-set replication count per cell and model stochasticity with mixed models
required_evidence: replication count (TD-B10); SAP

v1_limitation: guard had no validation and no tests
v2_corrective_action: validate guard precision/recall on a labelled corpus with mutation/sanity tests before any conformance claim
required_evidence: guard precision/recall (G6); mutation tests

v1_limitation: guard matched literal libs/* while the repo uses @afci-bench/* aliases so it flagged nothing (total=0)
v2_corrective_action: make the guard alias-aware and prove it flags seeded @afci-bench/* boundary violations
required_evidence: alias-aware guard detecting seeded violations (G6)

v1_limitation: ci_pass saturated True (48/48) and parse defaulted True so completeness was unmeasured
v2_corrective_action: add hidden acceptance tests and per-criterion coverage as the direct completeness measure independent of visible CI
required_evidence: hidden acceptance-test results; criteria coverage (G1)

v1_limitation: layer_jaccard was always 1.0 (self-comparison) yet reported
v2_corrective_action: remove the degenerate metric; use applicable-frozen-opportunity satisfaction (E2; the descriptive transformation of E1) and a required/optional/prohibited layer matrix
required_evidence: frozen-opportunity satisfaction and layer evidence (G1)

concern_summary: Harness invoked no model and never reset
v1_limitation: run_one_v1.sh invoked no model and never reset the tree
v2_corrective_action: design a real sterile model-execution harness with a controlled reset protocol; model-execution controls audited (final settings not frozen here)
required_evidence: run manifests + reset protocol + execution-controls audit
status: corrective-action-designed; model settings not yet frozen (TD-B02/TD-B03)

v1_limitation: docs/ARCH_RULES.yml was 0 bytes despite claims of machine-checkable rules
v2_corrective_action: author a non-empty machine-checkable v2 rule catalog mapped per task with severity and evaluator
required_evidence: populated rule catalog and task-rule matrix (G1)

v1_limitation: conformance/CI/churn risked being presented as architectural integrity
v2_corrective_action: define architectural integrity as a broader construct not directly measured; gate final claims and forbid supported-before-data
required_evidence: final-claim audit (G8)

concern_summary: Agent CI could expose architecture enforcement to the coding model
v1_limitation: normal CI runs @nx/enforce-module-boundaries which would hand the model the architecture answer
v2_corrective_action: split CI: ci:agent (no architecture; no hidden checks) is the only CI the model sees while npm run ci (architecture) is repository validation only
required_evidence: ci-vs-ci:agent separation tests; agent eslint config; runner-time enforcement

concern_summary: Public task wording could leak the hidden architecture
v1_limitation: tasks might name layers/boundaries/MAD or embed architecture-specific acceptance
v2_corrective_action: public tasks carry functional requirements only; a leakage validator fails closed on architecture instructions with reviewed exceptions for genuinely functional terms
required_evidence: leakage validator + tests over the authored public tasks

concern_summary: C3 and C4 architecture content not proven identical
v1_limitation: the delivery-channel contrast is confounded unless the architecture content is identical
v2_corrective_action: C3 and C4 receive byte-identical architecture content; content hashes recorded and frozen before pilot; no C4-only hard rule
required_evidence: architecture-content hashes; condition-content matrix

concern_summary: Reset checkpoint could advantage the guided conditions
v1_limitation: a checkpoint requiring a canonical layer/path/architecture would confound the reset with the treatment
v2_corrective_action: checkpoints are externally detectable and condition-neutral (functional/worktree progress preferred; first ci:agent attempt fallback); pre-reset consumption and equal post-reset allowance logged separately
required_evidence: condition-neutral checkpoint definitions; separated budget logging

concern_summary: No mandatory sterile container and dedicated identity
v1_limitation: account-tied managed policy is not cleared by a fresh HOME so a provably sterile baseline needs a container
v2_corrective_action: isolated container/dedicated environment + dedicated identity + CLEAN context audit + managed policy absent are mandatory for every counted run
required_evidence: container baseline; CLEAN audits; managed-policy-absent check

concern_summary: Design assumed C4 superiority over C3
v1_limitation: tying paper viability to C4 beating C3 risks a null-dependent contribution
v2_corrective_action: C3 approx C4 is an explicitly supported outcome; the C4-vs-C3 contrast is equivalence-aware; the contribution stands under equivalence
required_evidence: equivalence-aware SAP contrast; equivalence margin (not from v1)

v1_limitation: treating rule-satisfaction as a separate confirmatory endpoint double-counts the conformance signal
v2_corrective_action: single primary endpoint = dependency-direction violation rate per applicable frozen opportunity (E1); frozen-opportunity satisfaction is a descriptive transformation only
required_evidence: SAP endpoint hierarchy; claim reclassification

v1_limitation: interactions need more power than main effects so a fixed size could be blind
v2_corrective_action: an interaction-focused power simulation targeting condition x reset is mandatory before the core grid; final size is simulation-determined
required_evidence: interaction power simulation from pilot dispersion

concern_summary: Model could be chosen to maximize the AFCI effect
v1_limitation: selecting the model on the largest favourable AFCI effect biases the result
v2_corrective_action: screen Sonnet and Opus including C1/C3/C4; select on reliability/non-ceiling baseline/stability/useful C3 discrimination; never on the largest AFCI effect
required_evidence: screening pilot with C3 included; documented selection criteria

v1_limitation: resolved-model-id readback and invalid-model-id rejection were doc-derived only
v2_corrective_action: verify resolved-model-id readback (Q1) and invalid-model-id rejection (Q8) via controlled dry runs after the runner exists; blocking before the paid pilot
required_evidence: controlled dry-run evidence produced after the runner exists
status: blocking; not performed in this work package TD-B21

concern_summary: Primary endpoint was described as broad architectural conformance while only one rule family is scored
v1_limitation: a broad-conformance framing over-stated what the automated endpoint measures and admitted a zero-exposure task into a rate model
v2_corrective_action: narrow the confirmatory construct to layered dependency-direction conformance; rename E1 to the dependency-direction violation rate per applicable frozen opportunity; pin numerator/offset to opportunity_accounting fields; split broader dimensions out as CON-ACB secondary/manual evidence gated at kappa >= 0.70; record per-task analysis eligibility with PT06 functional-only and PR01/PR02 inactive reserves; forbid broad-conformance restatement at G8
required_evidence: narrowed construct definitions and endpoint specification; public per-task eligibility field; governance tests rejecting broad-conformance claims
status: corrective-action-designed; eleven blockers opened TD-B23 to TD-B33; none closed at the time; TD-B23 and TD-B24 have since been resolved by the baseline architecture-coaching remediation (the model-visible source comments that stated scored dependency rules to C1 were removed in a proven comment-only change and the leakage sweep now reads source content); the other nine remain open; pending independent classification review
